correctness.rationale: Every valid code is a clique in an explicitly generated 272-vertex, 11206-edge graph: self-unborderedness is necessary and all pair conditions define the graph edges. Exhaustive pivoted Bron-Kerbosch enumeration terminates and returns 4887344 maximal cliques with maximum cardinality 13, of which 4996 reach 13. Two distinct implementations, C++ and Python standard library, generate byte-identical complete optimum catalogues with expected SHA-256; direct verification of all 4996 codes, minimum distances, group-action closure and orbit sizes succeeds. The included source code provides the complete finite certificate; no extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The simultaneous requirements of constant composition, strict prefix-suffix synchronization and one aligned substitution correction arise naturally in constrained code design, as treated in arXiv:1601.08176. The exact maximum for length twelve and all 4996 optimizing codes closes a genuine finite multi-constraint extremal instance, not just a routine recurrence or construction. The 1249 symmetry classes reduce all labeled optimum designs, and none of the separately known relaxed optima determines these facts.
